secrets.name: The Crypt Under the Medallion
secrets.text: Under the medallion at the centre of the rotunda, a stair goes down to a low crypt: niches of books, a stone table, candles that somebody keeps lit. On the table a book lies open at a plan of the ambulatory, with an arrow going round it one way only.

meta.label: The Rotunda of the Long Way Round
meta.blurb: A domed rotunda in an octagonal ambulatory. Going round to the right takes a minute. Going round to the left, you keep finding yourself walking back the way you came.
